launchable_note: The lifecycle is launchable only once a validated attestation exists. This commit freezes a new build source; the successor contract, calibration and attestation are intentionally absent so a later registration can pin this source without circular Git metadata.
purpose: Freezes the C32 build source: the 53-patch engine after C27 (crit-arm kill split) and C31 (Substitute quarter-HP gate), and the certification consumers after C28 (majority-arm scoping of the structural rule), C29 (cap marking no longer changes bucket membership), C30 (the capped-heal bound receives the step's damage scale) and the fidelity KPI. Every one of those changes invalidated the C26 source identity by construction.

supersedes.why: C26 pinned the 51-patch engine and the pre-C28 readout. It was registered, its launcher enforcement and contract attestation were completed, and then a pre-launch diagnostic showed it would fail with roughly 4,800 unattributed rows. The sweep was deliberately held rather than spent, so its eight 1,250-game blocks from 16,000,000 remain unconsumed. Its artifacts stay as immutable evidence and its seed blocks stay burned rather than recycled.

matcher_era_note: differential_sha256 is pinned here as well as the readout hash, because the fidelity KPI's two terms both come from the differential. A KPI reading is comparable only against another sharing this hash.
